The '''2007 FA Community Shield''' (also known as '''The FA Community Shield sponsored by [[McDonald's]]''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 85th staging of the [[FA Community Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match played between the reigning [[Premier League]] champions and [[FA Cup]] winners. The match was played on 5 August 2007 between [[2006–07 FA Premier League]] champions [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] and [[2006–07 FA Cup]] winners [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], who beat United in the [[2007 FA Cup final|final]]. Manchester United won the game 3–0 on penalties, after the match finished 1–1. [[Ryan Giggs]] opened the scoring in the 35th minute, before [[Florent Malouda]] equalised just before half-time.

The match then went to penalties, where [[Edwin van der Sar]] saved all three of Chelsea's penalties, leaving [[Wayne Rooney]] to score his penalty and win the match for United.

It was the first Community Shield match to be played at the new [[Wembley Stadium]]. Manchester United and Chelsea also contested the last Community Shield (then the Charity Shield) to be played at the [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|old Wembley]] in [[2000 FA Charity Shield|2000]], with Chelsea winning the match 2–0.
